name: Payment Acknowledgement
description: Record the incoming transaction in the finance ledger and send a confirmation message to the payer via WhatsApp.
trigger_description: When a payment is received from a tenant or lead

steps.description: Log the payment amount and details into the finance ledger.
Send a thank-you WhatsApp message to the payer confirming receipt.

name: Visit Follow-Up
description: Update their CRM status to Visited, log the visit session with details, and send a follow-up courtesy message via WhatsApp.
trigger_description: After a prospective tenant completes a site visit

steps.description: Update the prospective tenant's status to 'Visited' in the CRM.
Record the site visit summary and notes in the CRM.
Send a courteous follow-up WhatsApp message to the prospect.

params.content: Thank you for visiting! Let us know if you have any questions.

name: Property Enquiry
description: Create a lead in the CRM system and send a confirmation template message to the enquirer acknowledging their interest.
trigger_description: When a new property enquiry is received from any channel

steps.description: Create a new lead entry in the CRM system for this enquiry.
Send a welcome and confirmation message to the enquirer acknowledging their interest.

name: Finance Contract Onboarding
description: Deterministic workflow for registering negotiated tenant contract terms.
user_view_steps: Take the approved tenant commercial terms.
Store these terms as the finance contract for that tenant.
Return success only after the contract is stored.
trigger_description: When finance contract terms are approved and must be locked.

steps.description: Persist negotiated contract terms in FinanceAI.

name: Finance Monthly Billing
description: Deterministic workflow for generating monthly rent/dues.
user_view_steps: Read the tenant contract already stored in finance.
Generate monthly bill entries for the target month.
Return the bill output and generated ledger entry IDs.
trigger_description: When scheduled or manual monthly billing must be generated.

steps.description: Generate bills for the target payer and month.

name: Finance Manual Ledger Debit
description: Deterministic workflow for append-only debit entries.
user_view_steps: Receive approved debit details for a tenant/payer.
Create exactly one new ledger debit entry.
Never modify old entries; keep ledger append-only.
trigger_description: When an approved manual debit must be added to ledger.

steps.description: Add a single append-only debit ledger entry.

name: Finance Incoming Payment Posting
description: Deterministic workflow for posting incoming payment after CEO confirmation.
user_view_steps: Wait for CEO confirmation that payment is visible in bank statement.
Record the incoming payment against payer ID.
Apply waterfall allocation and return allocation summary.
trigger_description: When CEO confirms payment is visible in bank statement.

steps.description: Post incoming amount and apply waterfall allocation.

name: Finance Outgoing Expense Posting
description: Deterministic workflow for recording approved outgoing transactions.
user_view_steps: Receive approved outgoing payment request.
Record one outgoing finance transaction with full context.
Return transaction ID and posting status.
trigger_description: When approved outgoing payment must be posted.

steps.description: Record outgoing expense transaction in finance ledger.

name: Finance Salary Payout
description: Deterministic workflow for salary payout posting.
user_view_steps: Receive approved payroll staff and month context.
Process salary payout through finance logic.
Return paid amount and payout transaction ID.
trigger_description: When salary payout cycle is approved.

steps.description: Process salary payout for staff and payroll month.

name: Send Month-End Itemized Bill
description: Generate the monthly itemized bill on the last day of the month and notify the customer on WhatsApp.
user_view_steps: Generate the itemized monthly bill for the customer.
Send the bill notification to the customer on WhatsApp.
Keep the bill link and customer reminder in the workflow trail.
trigger_description: On the last day of each month when the customer itemized bill must be generated and shared.

steps.description: Generate the customer bill in FinanceAI for the target month.
Send a WhatsApp message to the customer that the itemized bill is ready.

params.content: Your itemized bill for {{context.month_year}} is ready. Please review and pay within your selected cycle. Bill link: {{context.bill_link}}

name: Process Caretaker Salary On Last Saturday
description: Calculate caretaker salary on the last Saturday of the month, notify the CEO for disbursal, and send the salary slip to the caretaker.
user_view_steps: Calculate caretaker salary using the business salary rules.
Send the salary summary to the CEO for disbursal approval.
Send the salary slip summary to the caretaker.
trigger_description: On the last Saturday of the month when caretaker salary must be calculated and routed to CEO and caretaker.

steps.description: Calculate the caretaker salary in FinanceAI using unit, payment, proof, and complaint data.
Notify the CEO that the caretaker salary is ready for disbursal.

params.content: Caretaker salary for {{context.staff_name}} is calculated for {{context.month}} {{context.year}} and is ready for disbursal.

steps.description: Send the salary slip summary to the caretaker on WhatsApp.

params.content: Your salary slip for {{context.month}} {{context.year}} has been prepared and shared with the CEO for disbursal.

name: Confirm Customer Payment And Post To Finance
description: Once payment is received and the CEO confirms it, post it into FinanceAI and acknowledge the customer.
user_view_steps: Wait for CEO confirmation that the payment is actually received.
Post the payment into FinanceAI through the governed payment workflow.
Acknowledge the customer on WhatsApp.
trigger_description: When customer payment has been received and CEO has confirmed it.

steps.description: Post the incoming payment into FinanceAI after CEO confirmation.
Send payment acknowledgement to the customer.

params.content: We have confirmed your payment of ₹{{context.amount}}. Thank you.

name: Onboard Customer After Payment
description: After a negotiated enquiry has paid, assign the unit caretaker, send police verification, onboard the customer, send house rules and Wi-Fi access, and update the system records.
user_view_steps: Capture the negotiated payment terms and payment method in the customer record.
Assign the customer to the unit and lock the caretaker ownership for that unit.
Notify the caretaker and send the police verification request to the customer.
After verification is received, mark the customer onboarded and send house rules and Wi-Fi details.
trigger_description: When a negotiated customer has completed payment and is ready to be onboarded into a unit.

steps.description: Update customer CRM snapshot with negotiated payment terms and preferred payment method.
Assign the customer to the booked unit and set the caretaker owner for that unit.
Notify the assigned caretaker that the new customer is now mapped to the unit.

params.content: A new customer has been onboarded to your assigned unit {{context.unit_label}}. Please coordinate move-in readiness.

steps.description: Send the police verification form request to the customer.
Move the customer lifecycle from visited to onboarded after verification is received.

params.reason: Payment received, verification completed, unit assigned

steps.description: Send the house rules to the customer.
Send the generated Wi-Fi credentials to the customer.
Store final onboarding notes in CRM for operational traceability.

params.content: Customer onboarded with assigned caretaker, payment terms captured, police verification requested, house rules shared, and Wi-Fi credentials delivered.
params.author: system
